pr-workflow.serverUseInstructions: PR workflow (18 tools). PR info: get_pull_request (metadata), get_pull_request_files (changed files), get_pr_by_branch (find PR by branch name). PR feedback: get_pr_feedback (all review threads + top-level comments + review bodies, auto-paginated; bodies in separate files via bodyFile), resolve_pr_comment (reply+resolve), reply_to_pr_comment (reply without resolving), create_pr_comment (top-level comment). CI: get_ci_status, get_ci_failure_logs (stdout/stderr from failed jobs). Code scanning: get_code_scanning_alerts (CodeQL alerts by PR or branch), dismiss_code_scanning_alert (dismiss with reason). PR creation: create_pr. Branch: check_branch_status, check_merge_conflicts, start_merge_from_main, complete_merge, abort_merge. NEVER use gh CLI directly - use these tools.

codecov.serverUseInstructions: Coverage data from CI. Use get_pr_coverage(pull_id) FIRST for PR coverage - check gap_analysis.passing. run_tests_with_coverage for local testing. verify_local_coverage to compare local vs remote (requires base_commit from get_pr_coverage).

qstash.serverUseInstructions: QStash/Workflow operations using QSTASH_TOKEN (works with Vercel-integrated accounts). Query workflow runs, get detailed message logs, manage DLQ (dead letter queue), cancel/resume/restart workflows. Use for debugging workflow failures, viewing execution history, and managing failed jobs. Key tools: list_workflow_runs (see recent runs), get_message_logs (detailed step-by-step logs), list_dlq (failed workflows), resume_workflow/restart_workflow (retry failures).

examples: show me the last 10 workflow runs

dash0.serverUseInstructions: READ-ONLY observability for debugging (6 tools). No admin, no writes. Service names: prod=distro, stage=distro-stage. For quote logs: filter distro.invocation_id contains 'quote-<quoteId>'. For invoice logs: filter distro.invocation_id contains 'invoice-<reconciliationId>'. Key attrs: distro.invocation_id, otel.log.body, trace_id.

mongodb.serverUseInstructions: READ-ONLY database queries across ALL clusters (prod, test, dev). Before querying, MUST call atlas-connect-cluster with projectId '637189240609b04bd292d347' and the cluster name for the target environment. The dev cluster serves dev, stage, and preview environments (same database). Can switch clusters by calling atlas-connect-cluster again. ALWAYS specify database:'distro'. ObjectId format: {"$oid":"..."}. Collections: quote, enterprise, private_product, erp_connection, customer, platform_user, invoice, invoicereconciliation, knowledge_chatbot_conversation, customer_chat_conversation, customer_chat_message, intake_source, order, purchase_order, data_ingest_job, erp_submission, asyncjobstatuses, vendor (snake_case singular). Cluster names: prod, test, dev.

perplexity.serverUseInstructions: Web search for real-time info. perplexity_ask for quick answers (messages array format). perplexity_research for deep multi-source research. Include year (2026) in queries. Use BEFORE relying on training data for best practices, APIs, or troubleshooting.

examples: what is the latest React version

tavily-remote-mcp.serverUseInstructions: Web search alternative to Perplexity. tavily_search for general queries, tavily_research for comprehensive research. Run in parallel with Perplexity for cross-validation.

firecrawl-mcp.serverUseInstructions: Scrape/read specific URLs (6 tools). Use when user shares a URL and you need to read its content. Core: firecrawl_scrape, firecrawl_map, firecrawl_crawl, firecrawl_search, firecrawl_extract, firecrawl_check_crawl_status. firecrawl_deep_research and firecrawl_generate_llmstxt are disabled. Use Perplexity for deep research instead.

examples: read the content of this page

vercel.serverUseInstructions: READ-ONLY deployment observability (6 tools). No deploy, no admin. Check deployment status, get build logs, get runtime logs for debugging. list_teams for teamId.

context7.serverUseInstructions: External library docs. Use when writing code with React, Next.js, LangChain, MongoDB driver, or any rapidly-evolving library. Invoke when referencing library APIs that may have changed since training cutoff.

exa.serverUseInstructions: Advanced web search. web_search_exa for general search, get_code_context_exa for code examples from GitHub/SO, deep_search_exa for multi-angle research, crawling_exa to read URLs. deep_researcher_start/check for async AI research agent.

sentry.serverUseInstructions: READ-ONLY error debugging (4 tools): find_organizations, find_projects, get_issue_details (stack traces), analyze_issue_with_seer (AI root cause).

examples: find the stack trace for this error

next-devtools.serverUseInstructions: Next.js dev server interaction (5 tools). nextjs_index to discover servers, nextjs_call with port + toolName (get_errors, get_routes, etc), nextjs_docs, browser_eval, init. enable_cache_components and upgrade_nextjs_16 are disabled.

notion.serverUseInstructions: Knowledge retrieval + docs (5 tools). No admin. GET: notion-search, notion-fetch, notion-get-users. WRITE: notion-create-pages, notion-update-page. Primary source for ERP/API docs. Workflow: search → fetch → read embedded PDFs.

serena.serverUseInstructions: LSP-powered codebase intelligence (20k+ stars). PREFER over Grep/Read/SemanticSearch for code navigation. Context 'ide' disables file/shell tools that duplicate the IDE's built-ins. Key tools: find_symbol (locate functions/classes/vars by name), find_referencing_symbols (find all callers/usages of a symbol), get_workspace_symbols (search symbols by partial name across the repo), get_document_symbols (list all symbols in a file), get_definition (go-to-definition), get_references (find all references), get_hover_info (type info + docs for a symbol), insert_after_symbol/replace_symbol_body (structural edits at the symbol level). On first use, call initial_instructions to initialize. Use find_symbol FIRST when you know the name. Use get_workspace_symbols for partial/fuzzy name search. Falls back gracefully — if Serena can't find it, use Grep.

examples: what symbols are in this file

pylon.serverUseInstructions: Pylon B2B customer support platform. Query customer issues, accounts, and conversations across Slack, email, and chat channels. Use for checking customer tickets, support metrics, and account health.

examples: look up customer account in pylon

linear.serverUseInstructions: Linear project management. Use for creating issues, updating tickets, listing issues, managing labels and milestones.

github.serverUseInstructions: READ-ONLY official GitHub MCP for Actions, Repos, and Context (17 tools). Context: get_me (authenticated user profile), get_teams (teams for a user), get_team_members (members of a team). Actions: actions_get (workflow/run/job details), actions_list (list workflows/runs/jobs), get_job_logs (job log output with tail/failed-only). Repos: get_file_contents, get_commit, list_commits, list_branches, list_tags, list_releases, get_latest_release, get_release_by_tag, get_tag, search_code, search_repositories. No write operations. Do NOT use for PR operations — use pr-workflow. Do NOT use for issues — use Linear.

examples: get job logs for the failed workflow
